label: Generalized delay scaling
subgoals: Scale current, capacitance and voltage with kappa and s
Form delay as C V over I
Simplify to s over kappa squared

label: Generalized power density
subgoals: Write power per device as V times I under the scaling factors
Multiply by the kappa squared density increase
Simplify to kappa cubed over s cubed

label: Power density at fixed frequency
subgoals: Hold frequency fixed in C V squared f
Multiply per-device power by the density increase
Simplify to kappa over s squared
